entries.title: A part you asked to wait no longer holds up its main task unnoticed
entries.body: When every other part of a main task has finished and the one left is a part you asked to wait, a card now asks you once whether to start it. Start now starts it, Keep it waiting leaves it as it is, and a reply can change or drop it.

picture.alt: A card asks whether to start the one part a main task still waits on, with Start now and Keep it waiting
